component.name: Antiphon
component.summary: Music player with playlist sync and a parametric EQ

description.p: Antiphon is a music player in the spirit of RealPlayer 10: a glossy transport strip, a library you can browse by playlist, artist, album, genre or year, and a Now Playing queue.

ul.li: Import YouTube playlists and keep each one up to date individually; only newly added songs are downloaded
Audio kept in its original format (Opus or M4A), with MP3 as an option
Tag editor with batch editing and cover art
10-band parametric equalizer with a live response curve and presets
Themes written in CSS, including looks based on popular editor themes

description.p: Downloading from YouTube is only permitted in the cases its terms allow. Use the downloader for content you have the right to keep.
First release: playback, library, tag editing, playlist sync, equalizer and themes.
